description: What a project's terms rest on (PM-1053): its confirmed terms and its parent projects', the links between them, and 'order' — the terms in the order to read them, each after what it rests on, the ones resting on nothing first — with 'circles', terms whose definitions rest on each other (worth putting right). A link is 'dependsOn' (the definition rests on the other term), 'specialCaseOf' or 'oppositeOf'; its 'state' is 'confirmed' or, to a member who may write, 'proposed' — offered because the definition names the other term, waiting for a person (link_terms decides it). The order rests on confirmed links only. With 'term', only what stands within 'depth' links of it — the way to look at a large dictionary. Only terms whose source you may open. Only where the company's plan includes AI.

depth.description: How many links away from 'term', 1 to 3. Default 2.

term.description: A term — its id, or a spelling of it — to see only what is around it. Leave out for the whole project.

name: term_graph
